breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A bacterial infection of the colon secondary to infection with Clostridium difficile bacteria. This infection generally results from the loss of normal gut flora secondary to recent antibiotic use, and manifests as copious watery stools, with associated abdominal pain and myalgia. C. difficile is the most common cause of pseudomembranous colitis, and can progress to toxic megacolon if left untreated.

master.definition_en: A condition of reduced bone mass, with decreased cortical thickness and a decrease in the number and size of the trabeculae of cancellous bone (but normal chemical composition), resulting in increased fracture incidence. Osteoporosis is classified as primary (Type 1, postmenopausal osteoporosis; Type 2, age-associated osteoporosis; and idiopathic, which can affect juveniles, premenopausal women, and middle-aged men) and secondary osteoporosis (which results from an identifiable cause of bone mass loss).
synonyms_en: bone mineral density quantitative trait locus

mechanisms: Tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 11 inhibitor
Calcium sensing receptor positive allosteric modulator

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 被称为“沉默的杀手”，骨量流失初期毫无痛感，直到一次轻微跌倒或打喷嚏即可引发**髋部骨折（俗称“人生最后一次骨折”）**或椎体压缩骨折；流行病学证实髋部骨折后1年内全因死亡率高达17%–33%（长期卧床继发肺部感染、深静脉血栓肺栓塞及心肺衰竭）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 完全可防可治！单靠喝骨头汤和吃钙片远远不够，必须联用真正抑制骨流失或促进新骨生成的抗骨质疏松药物——如每年1针的唑来膦酸、每半年1针的地舒单抗（均已纳入国家常规药品目录）或促骨形成药特立帕肽/罗莫佐单抗，可将髋部与椎体骨折风险大幅降低40%–70%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/GBD未将骨质疏松单列为直接死因，但其引发的脆性骨折（尤其髋部骨折）导致全球每年数十万至上百万例超额死亡

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列骨松直接死亡人数，但髋部骨折后1年病死率达17%–30%

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球50岁以上人群约2亿例以上，约1/3女性和1/5男性一生中会经历骨质疏松性骨折（IOF）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国40岁以上人群患病率女性约20.6%、男性约5.0%（50岁以上女性达32.1%，中国骨质疏松症流行病学调查），全国患者超9,000万例，但规范用药率不足2%

standard_drugs.drug_class: 静脉双膦酸盐（抑制破骨细胞骨吸收）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 一线核心抗骨松用药（每年仅需静脉滴注1次，依从性极佳，首次输注可能有短暂发热肌痛）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国家集采后每支（5mg）约百元至数百元，年药费极低

standard_drugs.usage_role: 一线强效抗骨吸收皮下注射剂（每6个月1针，肾功能不全者亦可使用；注意不可擅自断药，停药前需序贯双膦酸盐防反跳骨折）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家药品目录谈判公开价

standard_drugs.name_zh: 特立帕肽 / 罗莫佐单抗
standard_drugs.drug_class: 甲状旁腺激素类似物 / 抗硬骨素（Sclerostin）双效单抗（强效促新骨形成）

standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 特立帕肽集采/国产上市后月费约数百元；罗莫佐单抗在国内逐步落地

non_drug_therapies_zh: 足量基础营养：每日元素钙1000–1200 mg + 维生素D3（800–1200 IU），但切记钙片不是抗骨松特效药，必须配合双膦酸/地舒单抗
居家防跌倒改造（卫生间扶手、防滑垫、夜间感应灯、穿防滑鞋），适度负重与平衡抗阻训练（太极拳等）
若发生老年髋部骨折，只要心肺耐受尽量在48小时内尽早手术固定或置换下床活动，切忌长期卧床保守治疗引发致命肺炎血栓
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 规范使用集采唑来膦酸或目录内地舒单抗+钙维D年费约1,500–4,000元人民币

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 抗硬骨素单抗罗莫佐单抗（Romosozumab，兼有促骨形成与抑骨吸收双效）在FRAME/ARCH 3期试验证实可快速降低极高危患者椎体与髋部骨折风险；2) AI结合常规胸部/腰椎CT机会性自动筛查骨密度与椎体骨折（AI4LS）正大幅提升无症状骨松的早期检出率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 我国存在严重的“三低”困境（知晓率低、诊断率低、规范抗骨松治疗率不足2%），绝大部分脆性骨折患者出院后仍只吃钙片；2) 地舒单抗擅自停药会导致反跳性多发椎体骨折，基层医生与患者停药序贯宣教严重不足；3) 基层双能X线骨密度仪（DXA）配置仍不均衡。

master.definition_en: Babesiosis refers to a condition caused by microscopic parasites that infect the red blood cells. Many people who are infected with Babesia parasites do not experience any symptoms of the condition. When present, signs and symptoms may include flu-like symptoms such as fever, chills, headache, body aches, nausea and fatigue. In severe cases, babesiosis can be associated with hemolytic anemia. Babesia parasites are primarily spread by infected ticks. Treatment is generally only required in people who develop symptoms of the condition. When necessary, affected people are often prescribed a combination of antimicrobial medications along with supportive care to manage symptoms.

master.definition_en: Ichthyosis vulgaris is a common skin disorder passed down through families that leads to dry, scaly skin. It often begins in early childhood. Treatment may include heavy duty moisturizers which contain chemicals that help the skin to shed normally, including lactic acid, salicylic acid, and urea. Ichthyosis vulgaris can be a nuisance, but it rarely affects overall health. The condition usually disappears during adulthood, but may return in later years. This condition is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern.

master.name_en: high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma of the corpus uteri
master.definition_en: High-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma of the corpus uteri is an extremely rare, aggressive, primary uterine neoplasm, originating from neuroendocrine cells scattered within the endometrium, characterized, macroscopically, by a bulky, frequently polypoid, mass with abundant necrosis located in the uterus and, histologically, by rosette-like and cord-like structures consisting of small, rounded cells with oval nuclei and scarce cytoplasm. Patients often present with dysfunctional uterine bleeding, pelvic or abdominal mass and, especially in later stages of the disease, abdominal pain. Symptomatic metastatic spread or symptoms related to a paraneoplastic syndrome, such as retinopathy, or Cushing syndrome due to ectopic ACTH production, may be associated.

master.name_en: Hepatitis B reinfection following liver transplantation
master.definition_en: A rare hepatic disease characterized by graft infection with the hepatitis B virus (HBV) after liver transplantation, due to persistence and reactivation of HBV in extrahepatic sites (also despite previous clearance of the HBs antigen from serum, as shown by laboratory examination), followed by re-invasion of the graft. It may develop between two weeks and several years post transplantation. Clinico-pathological features are variable and range from mild self-limited hepatitis, chronic active hepatitis, and fulminant hepatitis, to fibrosing cholestatic hepatitis. The condition is associated with significantly reduced graft survival rates and overall patient survival.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
